sentences.text: Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the applicant/accused,
relating to FIR/Crime No.21/2024 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station - Raoti,
District Ratlam (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 450 and 506 of IPC.
2. Prosecution story, in brief is that applicant is son of brother-in-law of the prosecutrix.

sentences.text: before Diwali, applicant committed rape upon the prosecutrix and threatened her that if she narrates the incident to her husband, he will kill her.
On 03.01.2024, at around 8.00 PM, applicant again committed rape upon her.
Thereafter, when the prosecutrix got knowledge that applicant had lodged an FIR against her husband, on 09.01.2024, as a counter blast, prosecutrix lodged report against the applicant.
3 . Learned counsel for the applicant/accused submits that the applicant has not committed the offence and he has falsely been implicated in the case as a result of counter blast.
It is submitted that FIR was lodged belatedly without any plausible explanation.
It is further submitted that case of the prosecution is not supported by medical report.
Prosecutrix is a married lady and mother of two children.
Applicant is in custody since 11.01.2024.
After completion of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
Trial will take considerable long time for its disposal, therefore, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
4 . On the other hand, learned counsel for the non-applicant/State has opposed the prayer and prayed for rejection of the application.

5. Having considered the rival submissions and after perusal of the case diary so also considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail hence, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant - Ram @ Ramchandra shall be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during pendency of the trial.
It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
7. This order shall be effective till the end of trial but in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
8. With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
